/bin/sh -lc "/opt/runtime/bin/python3 -c \"
import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import MaxAbsScaler

train = ad.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/train.h5ad')
dev_ctrl = ad.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/dev_controls.h5ad')
dev_tgt = ad.read_h5ad('/workspace/public_assets/dev_targets.h5ad')

train_X = train.X.toarray() if hasattr(train.X, 'toarray') else np.asarray(train.X)
dev_ctrl_X = dev_ctrl.X.toarray() if hasattr(dev_ctrl.X, 'toarray') else np.asarray(dev_ctrl.X)
dev_tgt_X = dev_tgt.X.toarray() if hasattr(dev_tgt.X, 'toarray') else np.asarray(dev_tgt.X)

scaler = MaxAbsScaler()
scaler.fit(train_X)
train_scaled = scaler.transform(train_X)
dev_ctrl_scaled = scaler.transform(dev_ctrl_X)
dev_tgt_mean = dev_tgt_X.mean(axis=0)
dev_ctrl_mean_orig = dev_ctrl_X.mean(axis=0)

cell_types = sorted(train.obs['cell_type'].unique())
ctrl_means = {}
stim_means = {}
for ct in cell_types:
    mask = train.obs['cell_type'] == ct
    ctrl = train_scaled[(mask.values) & (train.obs['condition'] == 'control').values]
    stim = train_scaled[(mask.values) & (train.obs['condition'] == 'stimulated').values]
    ctrl_means[ct] = ctrl.mean(axis=0)
    stim_means[ct] = stim.mean(axis=0)

ctrl_mat = np.stack([ctrl_means[ct] for ct in cell_types])
stim_mat = np.stack([stim_means[ct] for ct in cell_types])
diff_mat = stim_mat - ctrl_mat
cd4_idx = cell_types.index('CD4 T cells')
cd4_diff = diff_mat[cd4_idx]
cd4_ctrl_orig = scaler.inverse_transform(ctrl_mat[cd4_idx].reshape(1, -1)).flatten()
dev_ctrl_mean_scaled = dev_ctrl_scaled.mean(axis=0)

ratio = np.where(cd4_ctrl_orig > 1e-6,
                 dev_ctrl_mean_orig / np.maximum(cd4_ctrl_orig, 1e-6),
                 1.0)
ratio = np.clip(ratio, 0.1, 10.0)

# Baseline
base_pred = scaler.inverse_transform(np.clip(dev_ctrl_mean_scaled + cd4_diff, 0, 1).reshape(1, -1)).flatten()
print(f'Baseline (no scaling): MSE = {np.mean((dev_tgt_mean - base_pred)**2):.8f}')

# Uniform pow=0.22
scaled_022 = cd4_diff * (ratio ** 0.22)
pred_022 = scaler.inverse_transform(np.clip(dev_ctrl_mean_scaled + scaled_022, 0, 1).reshape(1, -1)).flatten()
print(f'Uniform pow=0.22: MSE = {np.mean((dev_tgt_mean - pred_022)**2):.8f}')

# Sign-aware with quick scan
up_m = cd4_diff > 0
dn_m = cd4_diff < 0
print(f'Up genes: {up_m.sum()}, Down genes: {dn_m.sum()}')

best = 1e9
bu = bd = 0
for up in np.arange(0, 0.51, 0.02):
    for dn in np.arange(0, 0.81, 0.02):
        sd = np.zeros(2000)
        sd[up_m] = cd4_diff[up_m] * (ratio[up_m] ** up)
        sd[dn_m] = cd4_diff[dn_m] * (ratio[dn_m] ** dn)
        pred = scaler.inverse_transform(np.clip(dev_ctrl_mean_scaled + sd, 0, 1).reshape(1, -1)).flatten()
        m = np.mean((dev_tgt_mean - pred)**2)
        if m < best:
            best = m
            bu = up
            bd = dn

print(f'Best sign-aware on dev: up={bu:.2f}, dn={bd:.2f}, MSE={best:.8f}')
\" 2>&1
"
